title: Keys gone, cables fine

complaints.says: My keys are gone from the room and my wedge. Everything's plugged in, I checked.

hints: Probe the stagebox input for Keys. If the signal arrives there, the problem is in the mixer channel itself.
cause: The Keys channel's input source had been switched to USB (computer playback), so it ignored the stagebox input.
lesson: Each channel picks its input: the stagebox (Network), local analog, USB or SD. After a recording or playback session, check that channels are back on Network.
